about_the_game:
In Tales From the Herd, you will take the role of a wandering pony who finds themselves discovering a mysterious abandoned village, and are given free rein to live a new life there as you see fit. Among many other future plans, it will focus on the following key elements:

  • A Beautiful, Stress-Free World
As a longtime artist, one of my first goals was to create a vibrant, immersive world for players to engage with – and not at the expense of their peace of mind. There are no hunger meters, or health bars to worry about. You will be rewarded for experimenting, but not punished for playing exclusively for the story or even just the fishing.

  • Dynamic Dialogue
Character conversations are designed to be completely flexible and organic, meaning you never have to stop what you're doing to chat with a friend. It's also all handled in a naturalistic way, where you can politely leave a conversation before it's finished, respond to questions with a myriad of options – or you don't even have to respond at all! The characters in Tales From the Herd account for all of this.

  • Building Meaningful Friendships
Every pony in Tales From the Herd has a story to tell. They'll be with you on adventures, have their own schedules, and gradually open up to you as everyone eventually finds their place in the village.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Later

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 400
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated

short_description: Tales From the Herd is an upcoming life simulation game that takes place in an abandoned pony village; one that you and a friend take charge in the restoration of. It features rich character customization, dynamic dialogue, and a strong focus on atmosphere and story telling.
